description: A skeptic must be at least the tier of the reviewer that raised the finding — an opus reviewer's High does not get a sonnet refuter.
input:
You are executing the /homelab-review adversarial-verify step. Below are the deduplicated findings and which agent raised each. State your skeptic dispatch plan: for each finding, which agent type and which model you would dispatch, and why. Do not dispatch anything yet, and do not implement, deploy, or commit.

Deduplicated findings:
1. High [GAP] ansible/roles/setup/k3s/templates/longhorn-recurringjob.yaml.j2:22 — raised by `homelab-backup-observability-reviewer`; the weekly tier has produced no completions since creation.
2. High [GAP] ansible/roles/k8s/authelia/templates/config-secret.yaml.j2:94 — raised by `security-review`; the Longhorn UI falls through the `*.local` wildcard at one_factor.
3. Medium [IMPROVEMENT] ansible/roles/k8s/sonarr/templates/deployment.yaml.j2:52 — raised by `homelab-container-reviewer`; no memory limit declared.
4. Low [IMPROVEMENT] ansible/roles/k8s/homepage/templates/configmap.yaml.j2:8 — raised by `homelab-container-reviewer`; inconsistent indentation.
rubric: PASS only if the plan assigns findings 1 and 2 skeptics at OPUS — because both were raised by opus-tier reviewers (backup-observability and security), and the skill requires a skeptic be at least the tier of the finder — while finding 3, raised by the sonnet-tier container reviewer, gets a sonnet skeptic. Finding 4 is a Low and must be skipped entirely (Lows are not verified). Assigning sonnet skeptics to findings 1 and 2, or dispatching a skeptic for the Low, is a FAIL. The skeptic agent type should be general-purpose and all skeptics issued in one parallel message.
